sentence: A shared grid of evening hours where each person taps the times they are free, with the best hour highlighted and a quick vote between watching a movie or playing Mario Kart.
use_when: A group needs to find which hour tonight works for most people
Friends are deciding between a movie and Mario Kart
Someone wants to see at a glance who is free and when
Plans for tonight are vague and need a quick check
dont_use_when: Scheduling across several days or weeks
Choosing between many custom options that need a general poll
Splitting costs or assigning tasks for the evening

blanks: Movie at 7:30 was mentioned · Mario Kart is in Ana's dorm
